D015_m001.question:
I guess the main thing is I just feel…blank. It’s been like this for a little over a year now. I still go to the salon, I do my clients’ nails, I smile and talk, but inside it’s like nothing lands. My head feels foggy most of the time, like I’m moving through thick air. I lose track of what I was doing or saying, even in the middle of a set. When it’s really bad, I lie in bed thinking it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up the next day. I don’t have a plan to hurt myself, but I do think about not being here a lot.

Lately, I’ve started feeling like people are watching me—like there are cameras in the salon or someone tracking my phone. Sometimes I see shadows or figures in the corner of the room, and when I look directly, there’s nothing there. Those things only started after I got really low like this. It’s making it harder and harder to function normally.

A. Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features
    B. Schizoaffective Disorder (Depressive Type)
    C. Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features
    D. Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type)
D015_m001.answer: A. Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features
